title: UnitAction
description: One proposed action for a specific unit inside a draft tactical plan.

action_type.description: Action category (e.g. retreat, reconnaissance, confirm_access, hold_position).

route.description: Route identifier to use (e.g. north-access), null if not applicable.

destination.description: Destination identifier (e.g. water-point-2), null if not applicable.

evidence_ids.description: RadioEvent or tool-call identifiers supporting this action.

human_approval_required.description: True if the action must be approved by the incident commander.

acknowledgement_required.description: True if the unit must acknowledge the instruction.
